market.label: Reporting market
market.hint: You can change this later in Settings → Market & compliance.

global.title: Global
global.body: GRI, ESRS, ISSB and TCFD; IEA / DEFRA factors.

cn.title: Chinese mainland & Hong Kong
cn.body: A-share and A+H issuers: CN-SSE, CSDS, HKEX ESG; MEE factors; data kept onshore.

welcome.cnGuidance: For A-share issuers the exchange guideline (CN-SSE) is mandatory for in-scope companies; A+H issuers also report under HKEX ESG. Calculations will prefer MEE factors:
welcome.cnReviewNote: We'll also set the market to China, data residency to mainland China, the time zone to Asia/Shanghai and the currency to CNY.

org.title: Build your reporting tree
org.confirmRemove: This removes the entity and everything under it. Assignments for these entities stop showing in reports.
org.pickEntity: Pick an entity from the tree to view and assign members.
org.readyBody: Once the tree looks right, jump into assignments — pick a GRI question, pick a user, pick the plant it applies to.
org.emptyBody: Then add business units under the group, subsidiaries under each BU, and plants/offices under subsidiaries.
org.noMembers: No members assigned to this entity yet.
org.scopeNote: The tree you build here is shared across every reporting framework — you do it once, not per framework. Right now you're preparing to report against {{framework}}; the same entities will power CSRD, CDP, TCFD and ISSB when they come online.
org.nextStep: The tree is in place. Next: {{step}}.

welcome.title: Welcome to Nexus
welcome.body: Your single workspace for collecting ESG data, drafting framework reports, and publishing assured disclosures. Take a quick tour to see where everything lives.

day.title: This is your day
day.body: Open assignments, review queue, and the next best action — all on one screen. Start here every morning.

frameworks.title: Frameworks become documents
frameworks.body: Pick a framework, open the editor, and fill it in like a document. Values link automatically across every report.

search.title: Cmd+K opens anything
search.body: Press ⌘K to jump to any page, run an action, or find a framework. ⌘N adds something new.

demo.title: Load demo sample
demo.subtitle: Pre-fills your workspace so you can try every flow in seconds.
demo.intro: This will create the following in your workspace. Existing data isn't touched. You can keep, edit, or delete anything afterwards.
demo.recommended: Existing data is not touched. Every step is also in the guided setup if you would rather start from scratch.

stagesCn.materiality: Material topics mapped to the CN-SSE topics

demo.ctaBody: One click fills an empty workspace with entities, targets, material topics and a reporting cycle, so you can try review, anomalies and publishing straight away.

guard.title: Live data not found
guard.message: This screen reads directly from the Nexus backend. The database appears empty — run the idempotent setup to provision tables and seed FY2022–FY2025 historical values.
guard.footnote: Idempotent. Creates tables if missing, seeds demo SPD data, safe to run multiple times.
